steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each theme is placed by its group size against the minimum of five and whether a sample size is stated.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 theme is reported for a group below five

findings.title: Theme reported for a group below five
findings.fix: Merge the group or withhold the theme

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] theme-manager.csv:12  Theme reported for a group below five.
       Fix: Merge the group or withhold the theme.
[medium] sample.md:19  Theme with no sample size.
       Fix: Add the sample size.
[low] theme-growth.csv:26  Theme not aggregated.
       Fix: Aggregate the theme.
Not checked: Causes of the scores.
pros: Checks a theme reported for a group below the minimum size (default 5), and a theme with no sample size.
cons: Not checked: Causes of the scores.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-engagement-survey-analysis skill on the records for this review.
